title: Inhibition of candidalysin production by methoxy-apo-enterobactin from Streptomyces ambofaciens CJD34 as a novel antifungal strategy against Candida albicans.
authors: Kim, Eui-Seong; Jeong, Hyeongju; Abbas, Mustansir; Um, Soohyun; Oh, Juntack; Moon, Kyuho; Lee, Kyung-Tae
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦抗真菌化合物抑制白色念珠菌毒力因子表达，分子对接仅用于排除直接结合转录因子，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Opportunistic fungal pathogens, responsible for over 300 million severe cases and 1.5 million deaths annually, pose a serious global health threat, especially in immunocompromised individuals. Among these, Candida albicans is a major cause of both superficial and invasive infections, which can progress to systemic candidiasis. One of the critical factors in C. albicans pathogenicity is the yeast-to-hyphal transition, which enables biofilm formation and promotes tissue invasion through the secretion of candidalysin, a cytolytic peptide toxin encoded by the ECE1 gene. In this study, metabolites produced by Streptomyces ambofaciens CJD34, isolated from soil samples, were screened for antifungal activity. Methoxy-apo-enterobactin (compound 1) was identified as a potential inhibitor of C. albicans virulence. Treatment with compound 1 significantly suppressed ECE1 expression and candidalysin production. In a murine subcutaneous infection model, topical application of compound 1 reduced subcutaneous colonization by C. albicans. Molecular docking analysis suggested that the inhibition of ECE1 expression was not mediated by direct binding to known upstream transcription factors, indicating an indirect mechanism of action. Collectively, these findings highlight compound 1 as a promising antivirulence agent targeting candidalysin-mediated pathogenicity in C. albicans.
abstract_zh: 机会性真菌病原体每年导致超过3亿例严重感染和150万例死亡，对全球健康构成严重威胁，尤其是在免疫功能低下的个体中。其中，白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）是浅表和侵袭性感染的主要原因，这些感染可进展为系统性念珠菌病。白色念珠菌致病性的关键因素之一是酵母相到菌丝相的转变，这一转变通过分泌由ECE1基因编码的溶细胞肽毒素——念珠菌溶素（candidalysin），促进生物膜形成并增强组织侵袭。在本研究中，从土壤样本中分离的链霉菌（Streptomyces ambofaciens）CJD34所产生的代谢产物被筛选其抗真菌活性。甲氧基-载铁蛋白（Methoxy-apo-enterobactin，化合物1）被鉴定为白色念珠菌毒力的潜在抑制剂。化合物1处理显著抑制了ECE1表达和念珠菌溶素的产生。在小鼠皮下感染模型中，化合物1的局部应用减少了白色念珠菌的皮下定植。分子对接分析表明，ECE1表达的抑制并非通过与已知上游转录因子的直接结合介导，提示其作用机制为间接方式。综合来看，这些发现凸显了化合物1作为一种针对白色念珠菌中念珠菌溶素介导致病性的有前景的抗毒力药物。
